title: Ori from the game "Ori and the Blind Forest"
author: vincentskc
archive_license_note: Objaverse distributes individual objects under their respective Creative Commons licenses. The original GLB author/license/source metadata and the current Sketchfab API both identify this object as CC BY 4.0.
file_changes: None. Runtime changes: uniform scale to 1.68 metres, translation to the branch, orientation towards the hall centre, adjusted body/nose materials, reduced eye emission, front-face rendering. The support, stone base, arc and 12 motes are authored separately for this project.
theme: Ori and the Will of the Wisps fan-art exhibit using an Ori character mesh originally titled after Ori and the Blind Forest; not an official Ori2 model.
attribution_location: Ori information card in index.html and docs/research/2026-11-06-ori-sculpture.md

other_resources_checked.author: rogeriofsalves1
other_resources_checked.result: The metadata API reports downloadable=true, with OBJ source and converted glTF/GLB archives. The official download endpoint returns HTTP 401 without authentication. Not imported; no viewer extraction used. This UID was absent from the inspected Objaverse index.
The page returned an HTTP 403 verification challenge. Download availability and asset-specific license could not be verified. Not purchased, downloaded or imported.

other_resources_checked.author: Kristian LaGrange
other_resources_checked.result: Current API metadata and archived GLB license were inspected. Its static T pose and 57,560 converted triangles were less suitable than the chosen crouching model. Previewed locally, not bundled.
